values.description: ASSY, GRIPPER, FOUR-BAR LEGS, ECCENTRIC CRANKS, STRANDBEEST V8

params.name: pin_clear
params.comment: printed pin in printed hole, play per side (user rule 0.10-0.15)

params.name: pin_d
params.comment: hole for the D3 printed pins

params.name: press_d
params.comment: coupler bore, X3: drawn 0.05 mm per side loose; small vertical holes print ~0.1-0.2 small, so the printed hole (~Ø3.0-3.1) grips the Ø3.1 pin (X1 Ø2.9 and X2 Ø3.05 were too tight, user 2026-11-18 / 2026-11-22; NEEDS PRINT TEST)

params.name: head_d
params.comment: counterbore for a pin head or barb

params.name: barb_d
params.comment: snap barb: 0.3 mm catch per side over the D3.4 hole

params.name: snap_slot
params.comment: slot that lets the two prongs close

params.name: shaft_d
params.comment: crank shaft, turns in the base and the top plate

params.name: shaft_bore
params.comment: round bearing hole for the crank shaft

params.name: journal_d
params.comment: Q column journal the rocker turns on

params.name: post_d
params.comment: Q column post (frame) and stub (top plate)

params.name: o_stub_d
params.comment: top-plate stub over the eccentric boss: second bearing of the crank shaft

params.name: ring_bore
params.comment: coupler ring on the eccentric boss, 0.15 mm per side
